name: retra
description: Private, local-first activity retrospectives for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review activity and track what matters.
interface.longDescription: Retra records a minimal local activity journal through trusted Codex hooks, follows user-selected themes, and creates evidence-based daily, weekly, and monthly Markdown reviews without sending data to an additional service.
defaultPrompt: Set up Retra on this computer.
Track a theme in my future retrospectives.
